Email.description: Email address of the person submitting the request for follow-up communication

examples: I am experiencing issues with API authentication when trying to create contact lists.

BENCHMARK_EMAIL_GENERATE_TICKET.description: Tool to generate a support ticket. Use when you need to create a help desk ticket for customer support or technical assistance.

examples: This is a test ticket created via API to verify the endpoint functionality.
